projects.name: Find an IKEA Location
projects.description: The purpose of this project was to provide a responsive store finder application, allowing users to view their local store’s hours, set their preferred store and more. Also using the Google Maps API, SCSS framework, and more. Furthermore, ensured my project manager’s ability to edit any content seen on this page such as store hours with a javascript algorithm which fetches the JSON database.

projects.name: Swipe Fright
projects.description: This is a project I built while I was learning web development. It was always a dream of mine to create a website catered to horror film fans, so I did it with swipe fright as a pet project. It is using tools including the React framework, SQL database, REST API in order to fetch the movies database, and plenty more. I took advantage of many open source APIs and libraries, often binding them together as dependent to one another (a methodology which I would eventually integrate to my IKEA stores web application).
